default_credentials_present.title: Default Credentials Present
default_credentials_present.description: Indicates whether any database account is configured with a known default username/password combination (e.g., root/root, sa/sa, admin/admin, postgres/postgres).

weak_credential_accounts.title: Accounts With Weak Credentials
weak_credential_accounts.description: List of database account usernames found to have trivially guessable passwords (e.g., password equals username, blank, or common dictionary words).

password_policy_enforced.title: Password Policy Enforced
password_policy_enforced.description: Whether the database engine has a native password complexity and minimum-length policy enabled and actively enforced for all accounts.

database_engine.title: Database Engine
database_engine.description: The specific database engine in use, which determines which default credentials, authentication mechanisms, and configuration parameters apply.

tls_enabled.title: TLS Enabled for Client Connections
tls_enabled.description: Whether the database listener has TLS/SSL enabled for encrypting client connections.

tls_enforcement_mode.title: TLS Enforcement Mode
tls_enforcement_mode.description: How strictly TLS is enforced for incoming client connections - whether plaintext fallback is permitted.

plaintext_port_open.title: Plaintext Listener Port Open
plaintext_port_open.description: Whether the database is actively listening on a port that accepts plaintext (unencrypted) connections.

encryption_at_rest_enabled.title: Encryption at Rest Enabled
encryption_at_rest_enabled.description: Whether the database engine or storage layer has transparent data encryption (TDE) or equivalent at-rest encryption enabled for data files, tablespaces, and WAL/redo logs.

backup_encryption_enabled.title: Backup Archive Encryption Enabled
backup_encryption_enabled.description: Whether database backup archives (full, incremental, and WAL/binlog archives) are encrypted before or during writing to disk or object storage.

storage_volume_encryption_type.title: Storage Volume Encryption Type
storage_volume_encryption_type.description: The type of encryption applied at the storage/filesystem layer beneath the database engine (e.g., LUKS, dm-crypt, cloud provider CMK, none).

data_classification.title: Data Classification Level
data_classification.description: The sensitivity classification of data stored in this database, reflecting regulatory and business risk if exposed.

network_interface_binding.title: Network Interface Binding
network_interface_binding.description: The network interface the database service port is bound to - public-facing, all interfaces, or restricted/loopback only.

inbound_source_restriction_configured.title: Inbound Source Restriction Configured
inbound_source_restriction_configured.description: Whether a host-based firewall rule or cloud security group restricts inbound connections to the database port from a defined set of trusted source addresses (not 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0).

granted_privileges.title: Granted Database Privileges
granted_privileges.description: List of database privileges or roles granted to the application service account (e.g., SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, CREATE, SUPERUSER, DBA, GRANT ALL).

has_superuser_or_dba_role.title: Superuser or DBA Role Assigned
has_superuser_or_dba_role.description: Whether the application service account has been granted a superuser, DBA, or equivalent administrative role that confers unrestricted database access.

privilege_scope.title: Privilege Scope
privilege_scope.description: The broadest scope at which privileges are granted to the application service account.

least_privilege_review_performed.title: Least Privilege Review Performed
least_privilege_review_performed.description: Whether a formal least-privilege access review has been conducted and documented for this application service account, confirming granted privileges match only what the application requires.

audit_logging_enabled.title: Audit Logging Enabled
audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether database audit logging is enabled at the instance or cluster level.

audited_event_categories.title: Audited Event Categories
audited_event_categories.description: List of event categories currently captured by the audit log configuration (e.g., 'authentication', 'privilege_escalation', 'ddl', 'sensitive_table_access', 'dml').

compliance_frameworks.title: Applicable Compliance Frameworks
compliance_frameworks.description: Regulatory or compliance frameworks that apply to this database (e.g., PCI-DSS, GDPR, HIPAA, SOX).

version_has_known_cve.title: Database Engine Version Has Known CVEs
version_has_known_cve.description: Indicates whether the currently running database engine version has one or more publicly disclosed CVEs affecting the engine itself (e.g., authentication bypass, privilege escalation, remote code execution).

days_since_patch_available.title: Days Since Security Patch Was Available
days_since_patch_available.description: Number of days elapsed since the vendor released a security patch addressing the known CVE(s) for this database engine version.

network_accessible.title: Database Engine Network Accessible
network_accessible.description: Indicates whether the database engine's service port is reachable from outside the host (i.e., not bound exclusively to localhost or protected by a network-level firewall rule).

authentication_required.title: Authentication Required
authentication_required.description: Whether the database enforces credentials (username/password or equivalent) before granting any connection or data access. False means anonymous or unauthenticated connections are permitted.

anonymous_user_accounts_present.title: Anonymous User Accounts Present
anonymous_user_accounts_present.description: Whether one or more anonymous (blank username) user accounts exist in the database engine that allow connections without credentials.

network_exposure_scope.title: Network Exposure Scope
network_exposure_scope.description: The network reach of the database port - whether it is bound to localhost only, an internal network, or externally reachable. Amplifies severity when authentication is absent.

backup_storage_permissions.title: Backup Storage Permissions
backup_storage_permissions.description: The access control level applied to the backup file location. Indicates whether backups are restricted to authorized users/services or broadly accessible.

admin_interface_network_exposure.title: Admin Interface Network Exposure
admin_interface_network_exposure.description: Indicates whether the database administration interface is accessible from untrusted networks, restricted to trusted IP ranges, or localhost-only.

mfa_enforced.title: MFA Enforced for Admin Interface
mfa_enforced.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is required for all logins to the database administration interface.

tls_enforced.title: TLS Enforced on Admin Interface
tls_enforced.description: Whether TLS/HTTPS is enforced for all connections to the database administration interface (plaintext connections rejected).

database_process_os_user.title: Database Process OS User
database_process_os_user.description: The operating system user account under which the database daemon process runs.

runs_as_dedicated_service_account.title: Runs as Dedicated Low-Privilege Service Account
runs_as_dedicated_service_account.description: Whether the database daemon runs under a dedicated, purpose-created low-privilege OS service account rather than a shared or privileged account.

process_uid.title: Database Process UID
process_uid.description: The numeric Unix user ID (UID) of the OS user running the database daemon process.

plaintext_credentials_present.title: Plaintext Credentials Present in Config Files
plaintext_credentials_present.description: Whether database configuration files contain plaintext passwords, connection strings, or key material (not referencing a secrets manager or vault).

config_file_permission_mode.title: Configuration File Permission Mode
config_file_permission_mode.description: The filesystem permission mode (octal string) of the database configuration file(s) containing credentials.

secrets_manager_integration_enabled.title: Secrets Manager Integration Enabled
secrets_manager_integration_enabled.description: Whether the database or application is configured to retrieve credentials from a dedicated secrets manager (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault) rather than storing them in config files.

global_max_connections.title: Global Max Connections Setting
global_max_connections.description: The database-wide maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed. A value of 0 or excessively high values indicate no effective cap.

per_account_connection_limit_enforced.title: Per-Account Connection Limit Enforced
per_account_connection_limit_enforced.description: Whether individual database accounts have explicit per-user/per-role maximum connection limits configured, preventing a single account from exhausting the connection pool.

enabled_privileged_features.title: Enabled Privileged Database Features
enabled_privileged_features.description: List of privileged or high-risk database features/plugins currently enabled (e.g., FILE, xp_cmdshell, dblink, http_endpoint, utl_file, openrowset).

feature_justified_by_business_requiremen.title: Privileged Features Justified by Business Requirement
feature_justified_by_business_requiremen.description: Indicates whether each enabled privileged feature has a documented and approved business justification. True means all enabled features are justified; false means one or more lack justification.
